title: A turn seal that ends late but seals nothing while nothing else commits on the site takes the turn's unsealed_start off, so its Undo is not refused
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout, with TEST_DATABASE_URL set to a Postgres the run may use, run: node --test --test-concurrency=1 --test-reporter=tap --test-name-pattern='late seal|handing a seal over' apps/tracy-web/test/door-follow-up.test.mjs apps/tracy-web/test/sites-route.test.mjs
S2: Record the exit code and the result of each test named in run.tests.
expect: S1 exits 0 and every test in run.tests reports ok, none skipped (the database was really used).

sealProvesStart is true for the dskeepjo T4b records (seal 1791570660534..1791570675835, sealed null, skipped null, door lead 40 ms; a restore that ended before, a cms-log-pull inside, the turn's own moment after).

sealProvesStart is false when the seal sealed or skipped something, when the door's lead is missing or above SEAL_LEAD_MAX_MS, when the seal's host times are missing, and when a job that may commit ran inside the seal's window (a moment that committed, a sealing seal, webroot-changes, a restore, an unknown kind, a failed or unended or never-polled job); a moment that committed nothing and a seal that sealed nothing inside the window do not count.
handOver marks a seal's turn unsealed_start in the same statement, marks nothing for a moment, and does not overwrite the verdict of a seal the sweep already followed through.

Through the doors: POST /turn whose seal outlives the wait answers unsealedStart true; after the host ends that seal with sealed null and the follow-up sweep runs, site_turn.unsealed_start is false and nothing is owed.
Through the doors: when the previous turn's moment (answered 202) committed inside the next turn's seal window, that next turn's unsealed_start stays true after the sweep.
evidence: Local stand 09/10/2026, dskeepjo.tracy.test turn session-92adbee5-821f-44fc-98b4-abf881aa13f7:1 (T4b): job 2e07c9b3d255 webroot-seal-outside ran 15.3 s on the host (16.5 s as tracy-web saw it) and answered {"sealed":null,"skipped":null,"outside":[]} with no other webroot job on the site; site_turn.unsealed_start stayed true and Undo was refused with SHARED_CHANGE cause unsealed.
fence: a late seal clears unsealed_start only when it proves the turn's start: nothing sealed or skipped, the door asked within SEAL_LEAD_MAX_MS, and no job that may commit ran in its window on the host's clock

tests: a late seal that sealed nothing, asked for at once, with nothing committing in its window proves the turn's start
a late seal proves nothing when it sealed or skipped something, or its door or its times cannot be trusted
a late seal proves nothing when something that commits ran while it waited
handing a seal over marks its turn as started unsealed in the same statement
L31: a late seal that sealed nothing while nothing else committed on the site takes the turn's unsealed mark off
L31: a late seal that sealed nothing keeps the mark when the previous turn's late moment committed while it waited
